dimension_justifications.soundness: The finite-pool, recorded-realization estimand and the displayed natural-strata arithmetic are coherent, and the manuscript carefully avoids unsupported causal or calibration conclusions. However, the two source records that motivate the audit cannot be traced to supplied primary artifacts, and neither the treatment nor score-to-outcome construction can be reconstructed.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The scope, SR/CV labeling, equations, and limitations are unusually explicit and readable. Tables 1--3 clearly separate source-reported values from independently checked arithmetic, though the paper's central factual record remains difficult to evaluate because the references A32-E1/E2 are opaque.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The paper provides a useful, narrow caution about cross-level summaries, single recorded decodes, and different-estimand comparisons. Its contribution is limited to a formal/provenance audit: it supplies no independently reproducible empirical finding, implementation, or released record.

paper_summary: This paper audits two source-reported GSM8K/LLaDA records: a natural-strata cross-level score--outcome difference of +0.2227 and a purportedly separate 400-item paired fixed-filler contrast of -0.0075. It formalizes the latter as a descriptive finite-pool contrast conditional on one recorded decode realization, verifies only printed arithmetic, and explicitly states that treatment, score, item, trace, and analysis artifacts are absent.
strongest_verified_contribution: The strongest verified contribution is the clear formal boundary in PDF p.2, Sec.3: the paired quantity is a finite-pool contrast conditional on a recorded single-decode realization, while the natural-strata record is a different-sample, different-estimand contextual record; the p.3 arithmetic checks are also correct from the printed values.
strengths: PDF pp.1--3 consistently marks empirical numbers as source-reported/cannot-verify and does not convert missing evidence into causal, calibration, or decoder-expectation claims.
The p.2 Sec.3 estimand is explicit about the finite pool P, paired arms, stored realization omega, and the boundary against averaging over decoder randomness.
The natural-strata decomposition on PDF p.3, Sec.4.1 is arithmetically correct: -0.0314 - (-0.2541) = +0.2227.
PDF p.3, Sec.4.2 correctly notes that the separately printed three-decimal arm means need not reproduce a four-decimal contrast, avoiding a false claim of numerical inconsistency.
The supplied manifest hashes all included reviewer-safe files successfully, and the PDF is anonymous, four pages total with references on p.4; the main text is within the nine-page ICLR limit.
questions: Can the authors provide a reviewer-safe, immutable A32-E1/A32-E2 crosswalk that identifies the exact archived source records and hashes the underlying manifests, rows, traces, and analysis outputs?

Can the paired treatment be made replayable by releasing the literal filler, insertion/serialization rule, tokenizer version and dose check, arm execution/decode configuration, model revision, and per-item pairing identifiers?
What exact token-level score/readout and token-to-final-answer aggregation define s_i, and what evidence establishes the event whose correctness y_i is matched to that score?
Can citation provenance be completed for the GSM8K and LLaDA references and linked sentence-by-sentence to the claims they support, in addition to the partial citation lock?

issues.location: PDF p.1, Sec.1, lines 53--56; PDF p.2, Sec.2, lines 77--83 and Table 1; evidence/claim_evidence_map.tsv (A32-C1--C3); evidence/repository_inventory.md, “Not located.”
issues.observed_evidence: The package explicitly describes A32-E1 and A32-E2 as opaque references to missing experimental records. The supplied inventory confirms that neither source record, an ID-to-file crosswalk, item rows, manifests, or analysis outputs are present. Thus the reported +0.2227 and -0.0075 values can be transcribed but not traced to immutable primary evidence.
issues.why_it_matters: The central factual premises of the audit are not independently checkable. Disclosure prevents this from being a demonstrated numerical error, but it leaves the empirical record, sample separation, and whether the cited summaries actually originate from the stated analyses as cannot_verify.
issues.required_fix: Release or cite an immutable reviewer-safe artifact archive for A32-E1 and A32-E2, with a stable ID-to-file crosswalk, hashes, item manifests/identifiers, arm-level or item-level summaries sufficient to reproduce Tables 2--3, and a table-generation script.
issues.verification_test: Starting only from the archived artifacts and documented command, independently regenerate Tables 2 and 3, confirm the stated natural-versus-paired sample relationship/overlap status, and verify every displayed contrast before rounding.
issues.evidence_needed: Hashed primary source records, manifest/selection rules, paired rows or sufficient aggregate provenance, analysis code, and reproducible table outputs.

issues.location: PDF p.2, Sec.2, lines 77--83; PDF p.2, Sec.3, lines 88--104; PDF p.3, Sec.4.2, lines 126--149; evidence/method_provenance.tsv (A32-M1, A32-M2).
issues.observed_evidence: The manuscript and provenance table state that the literal 37-token filler, insertion location, prompt serialization, tokenizer dose fixture, model/tokenizer revision, decode configuration/traces, score construction, and gate implementation are absent. The formal definition therefore labels s_i and y_i only as source-recorded quantities rather than reproducible measurements.
issues.why_it_matters: The finite-pool estimand is formally well-defined conditional on presumed stored outputs, but the claimed Short/Long intervention and the semantic relation between commit score and final-answer correctness cannot be replayed or audited. This is a cannot_verify limitation rather than proof that the intervention was wrong.
issues.required_fix: Provide a versioned executable protocol that fixes the prompts, filler placement, tokenizer and token-count assertion, item assignment/pairing, model and decoder versions/configuration/seeds, score readout and token-to-answer aggregation, final-answer matcher, and output schema; include stored traces or deterministic replay evidence.
issues.verification_test: Run the supplied protocol from a clean environment lock; verify the 37-token dose at the declared insertion point, reproduce paired row identifiers and aggregate values, and independently inspect that score and correctness are generated according to the documented definitions.
issues.evidence_needed: Protocol/code, environment lock, immutable model/tokenizer identifiers, prompts, traces or deterministic replay, per-item score/label records, and matcher fixtures.

issues.why_it_matters: The present text is cautious about literature scope, but citation provenance is incomplete: a future reader cannot use the supplied lock to distinguish verified background references from the untraceable source record on which the audit is based.
issues.required_fix: Expand the citation lock to include every in-text citation, its canonical metadata/identifier, the exact local claim it supports, and an explicit distinction between background citations and the archival provenance of the source-reported record.
issues.verification_test: For each in-text citation, check that a citation-lock entry has matching metadata and directly supports the localized sentence; separately confirm that the source-record archive for A32-E1/E2 is identified rather than conflated with GSM8K/LLaDA background citations.
issues.evidence_needed: Complete citation-lock entries and a stable primary archive citation for the two audited records.

ethics_concerns: No direct human-subject, privacy, or deployment-harm issue is demonstrated in the frozen package. The principal responsible-research concern is epistemic: source-reported measurements must not be presented as independently established; the manuscript appropriately discloses this limitation.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control. The manuscript itself includes an AI-assistance disclosure on PDF p.3, Sec.6, lines 182--185.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A public or reviewer-safe immutable archive that permits full reconstruction of A32-E1/A32-E2, including hashes, crosswalk, manifests, rows/traces, treatment specification, score/matcher definition, analysis code, and environment.
A deterministic replay or multiple paired-decode realizations showing what uncertainty/decoder-run scope is supported, while retaining the finite-pool boundary if broader inference is not justified.
A complete citation-provenance lock and stable archive citation for the source record, plus regenerated tables that match the manuscript.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: Discovery that A32-E1 and A32-E2 do not correspond to the stated samples, arms, or arithmetic after source artifacts are released.
Evidence that the 37-token intervention, pairing, score readout, or final-answer matcher differs materially from the manuscript's source-described labels.
Evidence that the natural-strata and paired records are treated as comparable despite the stated different-sample/different-estimand boundary.
review_limitations: This was a read-only review of only the frozen submission contents; the instructions prohibit inspecting any parent directory, history, internet source, or unbundled artifact.

The absence of primary experimental artifacts prevents adjudicating whether source-reported quantities are factually correct; I therefore classify those matters as cannot_verify, not as demonstrated errors.
The PDF contains no figures and four pages total; assessment of visual layout was limited to the rendered PDF text/tables and PDF metadata.
